name: Lucy
source:
A female photographer.

The protagonist's partner turns the rape photos he takes into cash and also gives him advice on photography.

Her appearance and proportions are almost sexually offensive.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.sp-janis.com/soleil/itsudatsu/]official site[/url]]
